people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
translations.bsb: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and cut off forever.
translations.kjv: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
translations.asv: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob, shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
